# National Geographic

> A premier source for exploration, discovery, and in-depth reporting across science, history, culture, travel, health, animals, and photography.

National Geographic delivers authoritative journalism and visual storytelling on global topics ranging from archaeological discoveries and space exploration to cultural traditions, wildlife conservation, and human health. The site offers magazine subscriptions across multiple formats and serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding our world.

## Key Topics

- Magazine Subscriptions
- Cultural Traditions
- History & Archaeology
- Space Exploration
- Travel & Destinations
- Wildlife & Animals
- Health & Science
- Photography
- Islamic Holidays
- Environmental Conservation
- Global Perspectives
- NASA Artemis
- Archaeological Discovery
- Ramadan & Eid al-Fitr
- Natural History

## Subscriptions & Memberships

- [National Geographic Magazine Subscriptions](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/subscribe): Subscribe to National Geographic Magazine and related publications in print and digital formats

## History & Archaeology

- [When did humans arrive in the Americas? A new study reignites the debate](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/article/monte-verde-redated): Archaeological study on human migration to Americas via Monte Verde site
- [Britain's greatest naval hero left a riddle with his 'final' words](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/article/horatio-nelson-final-words-debate): Historical mystery surrounding Admiral Nelson's last words at Trafalgar
- [A century ago, Japan's countryside was full of grain and nature deities](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/article/rural-japan-a-century-ago): Archival photography exploring rural Japan's agricultural life a century ago
- [Nowruz is a celebration of springtime—and a brand new year](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/article/nowruz-ancient-festival-celebration-springtime-new-year): Ancient Persian New Year tradition and spring equinox celebration

## Science & Space Exploration

- [Artemis II: An inside look at NASA's journey back to the moon](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/graphics/artemis-ii-moon-mission-nasa): Inside look at NASA's Artemis II lunar exploration mission and space program

## Travel & Destinations

- [Why millions escape to Muskoka—Canada's 'cottage country'—every summer](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/heated-rivalry-muskoka-canada): Travel guide to Muskoka, Ontario's glacier-carved lakes and cottage country
- [When and where to see the best cherry blossoms in the U.S.](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/cherry-blossom-bloom-predictions-spring): Cherry blossom bloom predictions and travel guide for U.S. destinations
- [Beyond cherry blossoms, here are 5 U.S. flower festivals that summon spring](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/spring-flower-shows): Guide to five U.S. spring flower festivals and seasonal celebrations

## Culture & Global Perspectives

- [What is Eid al-Fitr? See how Muslims celebrate the end of Ramadan](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/article/eid-al-fitr-ramadan-celebrations-around-the-world): Global perspectives on Eid al-Fitr celebrations and Ramadan observances

## Health, Animals & Environment

- [This is the best time of day to eat fiber](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/health/article/fiber-morning-health-benefits): Nutrition science on optimal fiber intake timing and health benefits
- [How much exercise is safe during pregnancy? New research offers answers](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/health/article/exercise-during-pregnancy-new-research-safety-benefits): Research on pregnancy exercise safety and maternal health benefits
- [Meet the 'firefighting' donkeys of Spain](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/article/donkey-firefighters-wildfires-spain): Doñana's donkey battalion preventing wildfires through sustainable grazing
- [The reverent quest to find the East Coast's most majestic trees](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/photography/article/east-coast-giant-trees-conservation-new-york-gathering-growth): Giant tree hunting and old-growth forest conservation on the East Coast
